title: China population top-up
text: T-4028: China uses the 2020 census; the fast-growing cities are 2-7% above it at 2024 year end (Hefei +6.7%, Hangzhou +5.8%, Changsha +5.7%, Shenzhen +2.4%). Scale the top 20 metros to newer totals (2-3 h), all of China (8-12 h), or nothing? I'd do nothing for now. And where did the player complain (it isn't in the feedback inbox)?

title: Riders take the first-arriving train
text: T-4041 (from T-4019, the express complaint): riders now take the first train worth taking, so Newark to Trenton goes 61% on the local even though the express is 10 min faster at the same fare. Should riders know when each train leaves and board the one that arrives first? About 3-4 h to prototype, 4-6 h more to land; Newark to Trenton would go to about 59% express. I'd say yes.
